result.title: Can Learning to Answer Spatial Questions Improve Novel-View Generation?
result.summary: Generating novel views from limited observations requires preserving both the appearance and spatial structure of a scene. Although recent approaches exploit fine-grained geometric cues, they do not explicitly model high-level semantic and spatial properties such as object identity, attributes, and inter-object relationships. In this work, we investigate whether 3D language understanding can provide complementary supervision for novel-view generation. We introduce Ask4NV, built on a pretrained unified multimodal model with a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. Our model incorporates camera geometry into both VAE and ViT representations and leverages understanding features during generation through joint self-attention with a modality-aware attention masking strategy. Experiments demonstrate strong image quality and geometric consistency in novel-view generation, alongside competitive 3D language understanding. Further analysis shows that joint training improves cross-view correspondence in VAE representations and similarity in a 3D-aware feature space.

AI.brief_summary: 论文考察 3D 语言理解能否为 novel-view generation 提供互补监督，提出基于 MoT 统一多模态模型的 Ask4NV：把相机几何注入 VAE 与 ViT 表示，并通过联合自注意力与模态感知注意力掩码在生成中利用理解特征，报告了图像质量、几何一致性及 3D 语言理解表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其模态感知注意力掩码与联合自注意力给出了「理解特征如何进入生成内部状态」的可核查方法线索；对 VAE 表示跨视角对应与 3D 感知特征空间相似度的分析，也可能与 LVR 中视觉细节是否保留、latent 相似度受内容与结构影响的问题相关，但属推测。
